title: Gift shop in Torrance (Del Amo)
assumptions: An existing company. Hires staff. Moves into the space as it is (no build-out) with no new sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Seller's permit
items.agency: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration
items.note: "Every location must have this permit to sell taxable goods." Also on the LA restaurant checklist.

items.name: Employer payroll tax account registration (DE 1)
items.note: Register within 15 days of paying more than $100 in wages in a calendar quarter.

items.name: Fictitious Business Name statement
items.condition: Only when trading under a name other than the legal name.

items.name: Business license
items.agency: City of Torrance Finance Department, Business License
items.quote: You need a business license if you: Have a company located in Torrance

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
mustNotInclude.why: A store that sells no food needs no food permit.
